name: thermo
description: Benchmark Mac CPU, GPU, memory and temperature while your agent runs tests or builds.
long_description: Official MCP server of Thermo for Mac (github.com/simarpreetsingh-019/Thermo). Start a benchmark, run your tests or build, stop it, and get CPU/GPU/memory averages and peaks, temperature rise and throttling time. Compare before/after runs as a Markdown table for pull requests, check headroom before heavy jobs, and wait for the Mac to cool. Reads Apple Silicon and Intel sensors locally, needs no admin rights, sends nothing over the network. All tools are read-only.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: CPU, GPU, memory, hottest temperature and thermal state right now

tools.name: get_temperatures
tools.description: Temperature of every part (cores, GPU, memory, SSD, battery) against its safe range

tools.name: get_top_processes
tools.description: Apps using the most CPU and memory, grouped by app or project

tools.name: get_battery
tools.description: Battery charge, health, cycles and temperature

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Per-minute CPU, memory, GPU and temperature for the last 24 hours

tools.name: check_headroom
tools.description: Whether the Mac has room for a heavy job now (go / wait / no)

tools.name: start_benchmark
tools.description: Start recording CPU, GPU, memory and temperatures

tools.name: stop_benchmark
tools.description: Stop recording and return averages, peaks, heat rise and throttling

tools.name: compare_benchmarks
tools.description: Before/after comparison with a Markdown table for pull requests

tools.name: wait_until_cool
tools.description: Wait until the Mac is cool enough for the next heavy job
